title: Kissed Golden Canadian Crepes Pancakes
description: A nostalgic Canadian dish featuring milk and a touch of flambe, these crepes pancakes are a funky and springy treat, low-fat-friendly and perfect for any time of day. They are made with a delicate balance of ingredients to create a truly unique flavor experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and whisk until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in just enough batter to coat the bottom of the pan.
Tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over, cooking for another minute.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the crepes are cooked.
To flambe the crepes, add a small amount of grand marnier to the pan and ignite it, letting it burn for a few seconds before extinguishing the flame.
Serve the crepes hot, kissed with the golden flambe and enjoy.
